record.finding: The general Swedish following-distance duty requires adaptation to avoid rear collision on slowing/stopping, without specifying a fixed three-second interval.

Chapter 4 §20 version applicable before 1 December 2026 supports the scoped 80/40/30 trailer limits; future amendment not applied early. Chapter 3 §14 supports appropriate speed.
